question: Which divine abode and lordship are honored through obeisance to the Meru-dwelling lord of gods?
premises: The deity is addressed as having Meru as abode.
The deity is addressed as the supreme lord of gods.
Obeisance is offered to these aspects of the deity.
inference: The supreme deity is honored as both Meru-dwelling and lord of the gods.
plain_english: Obeisance to the one whose abode is Meru; obeisance to the supreme lord of the gods.
